name: ppmr-read
why: MRC c15,c2,4 (ARM1176 peripheral port remap) does not exist on ARM11 MPCore -> mov r3,#0

name: ppmr-write
why: MCR c15,c2,4 in the vector-page reset path -> nop

name: ifar-pabt-user
why: IFAR (c6,c0,2) is absent on MPCore: the handler already did lr -= 4 at 0x800662ac, so fault address = lr (mov r1, lr)

name: ifar-pabt-kernel
why: IFAR (c6,c0,2) is absent on MPCore: fault address = lr after the entry lr -= 4 (mov r5, lr)

name: actlr-write
why: ARM1176 ACTLR bits mean different things on MPCore (bit5 = SMP): ignore writes

name: uart-tx-data
why: S5L UART transmit: ldr pc,=shim_putc (log ring read by the ARM9)

name: uart-rx-data
why: S5L UART receive: mov r0,#0; bx lr

name: rtc-wait-0s
why: AppleARMPE::getGMTTimeOfDay waits 30 s for an RTC that doesn't exist yet (PMU/MCU driver TODO): timeout 0

name: iortc-wait-2s
why: IOKitInitializeTime (bsd_init, 0x8024a53e) waits 30 s for resourceMatching("IORTC") before clock_initialize_calendar; nothing publishes IORTC yet (no RTC driver). 2 s, not 0: with 0 the calendar can be initialised before AppleARMPE (gIOPlatform) is up, and early userland gettimeofday deltas then read 0 (gltest "frame took 0 ms", QEMU and hardware run10). AppleARMPE is up within 1 s even in plain QEMU, so 2 s keeps the original order

name: clcd-backlight-log-set
why: IOLog('%s, Where is my backlight?') in the backlight-level setter (0x807a9514)'s no-backlight-service branch -> nop. The 3DS has no S5L backlight service (the MCU daemon drives the LCD backlight), and since lock/wake cycles (re-log 41) the line was printed ~3 times a second (3504 lines in soak 6), flooding the console and the SD log

name: iic-device-transfer
why: AppleARMIICDevice transfer (vtable slot 0x35c: op, sub-address, data) -> shim_iic_transfer: a register file per I2C device instead of a bus that does not exist (Thumb: nop; bx pc; nop; ARM: ldr pc,[pc,#-4]; .word)

name: i2s-start-no-lrck-sync
why: AppleS5L8900XI2SController DMA start (7E18 0xc0565928, state at +0x8c): start in state 3 (synced) instead of 1 so it does not wait for GPIO 44 edges (see 4.2.1 0x8066d490). Needs the shim's audio IRQ glue to enter this kernel's IRQ path (audio_glue.S, re-log 130)

name: pe-get-gmt
why: PEGetGMTTimeOfDay -> shim_mcu_get_gmt (Thumb: ldr r3,[pc]; bx r3): Unix time from the 3DS MCU RTC (ARM9 mailbox, docs/mcu.md); without an RTC the shim runs the original body (gIOPlatform->getGMTTimeOfDay(), vtable +0x390)

name: pe-set-gmt
why: PESetGMTTimeOfDay -> shim_mcu_set_gmt: AppleARMPE::setGMTTimeOfDay (0x802e7834) waits 30 s for an IORTC that never appears; the shim keeps iOS' time as an offset to the RTC instead (the 3DS RTC is not written)

name: pe-halt-mcu
why: PEHaltRestart: gIOPlatform->haltRestart(type) (ldr r2,[r0]; movs r3,#0xe2; lsls; adds r1,r5,#0; ldr r3,[r2,r3]) -> adds r1,r5,#0; ldr r3,[pc,#0]; b +2; .word shim_mcu_halt_restart; the blx r3 at 0x801c9900 stays. Halt/restart power the console off through the MCU (ARM9), other types go to the platform as before

name: pe-halt-skip-pm
why: PEHaltRestart: skip the IOPMrootDomain halt/restart broadcast (blx r3 -> 0x801db12b). It messages IOMobileGraphicsFamily -> AppleM2CLCD (disable_backlight) -> AppleARMPlatform function -> AppleS5L8720X's SWI backlight function, which sleeps on a command gate (AppleS5L8720X+0x37cc) for an interrupt the 3DS never raises: every iOS shutdown hung there forever (QEMU, SELECT+START thread dump, re-log 33). File systems are already unmounted and md0 writes are synchronous; the platform call that follows (pe-halt-mcu) powers the console off

name: uart-init
why: 7E18 S5L UART init: return at once (MMIO does not exist on the 3DS; tx/rx go to the shim)

name: uart-tx-ready
why: 7E18 UART transmit-ready: always ready (mov r0,#4; bx lr)

name: uart-rx-ready
why: 7E18 UART receive-ready: never (mov r0,#0; bx lr)

name: timer-get-abstime
why: 7E18 cpu_data timer hook (offsets +4 vs 8C148): 64-bit timebase from the MPCore watchdog

name: timer-get-decrementer
why: 7E18 timer hook: MPCore private timer counter

name: timer-set-decrementer
why: 7E18 timer hook: arm the MPCore private timer

name: irq-entry
why: 7E18 _fleh_irq: IRQ entry -> shim (GIC ack, timer -> kernel FIQ); continuation 0xc0068458

name: mdevstrategy
why: 7E18 memdev strategy -> ARM9 block server. The bdevsw[2] strategy pointer installed at runtime is 0xc0074021, i.e. the function at 0xc0074020 (it calls buf_count 0xc007950c and buf_biodone 0xc007ac6c, like 8C148's 0x80072bf8). The earlier patch hit 0xc0073f94, a different memdev helper with (dev,bp) arguments that bdevsw never calls, so the root mount looped with 0 md0 requests. The real strategy takes buf_t in r0, so the original Thumb ldr r3,[pc]; bx r3 stub works here.

name: commpage-gtod-off
why: 7E18 commpage_set_timestamp: beq -> b, never publish the gettimeofday timestamp

name: s5l-perf-nowait
why: AppleS5L8720XClockController: after starting a performance-state change it sleeps on its command gate until byte +0x248 is cleared by the change-done interrupt, which the fake clock/power page never raises (the 8C148 s5l-perf-nowait, +0x38c there). Every display sleep (Lock) lowers the performance state, so the CLCD power path blocked here and Home never turned the display back on (re-log 128/129). ldrb r3,[rX,#0x248]; cmp r3,#0; bne wait -> mov r3,#0; strb r3,[rX,#0x248]; nop
